static: no nonland card in the seat's list is `AI:RemoveDeck:All` after the repo's overrides
every card in the list has a Forge script
dynamic: the commander resolved in at least 80% of the games the seat played
no card the pod names as the seat's `engine` (our seat: the deck's own engine set) was never cast or held while castable
our seat: wheels fired with a commander out at least 90% of the time, and at least one wheel a game (a wheel deck only)
definition.floors: a card named in the seat's hints as a floor is reported and never fails the seat

limits: STATIC reads the installed scripts: a card that is castable but that the AI holds for its own reasons shows only in the DYNAMIC half, which needs a run.
DYNAMIC held counts are lands left untapped and a commander gate open (colours and rocks ignored); `raw_only` names what the lands-only count alone would call held.
An opponent seat is an EDHREC average list unless its decklist was pasted over.
